findings.message: Dropping the `hasattr(self.bundle, "signed_url_template")` guard changes behaviour for deployments that still have a `dag_bundle` row but configure the view URL through the deprecated manager path: they used to get a URL and will now silently get `None`. If the intent is only to avoid the deprecation warning on every call, consider falling back to the manager when `render_url()` returns `None` (or gate the fallback on the template being unset) rather than removing it outright.

This drops the `session.merge(latest_dagcode)` call, which is unrelated to the stated fileloc fix and unexplained. If `latest_dagcode` is guaranteed to be attached to the same session the removal is fine, but that is worth stating in the comment (or keeping an explicit `session.flush()`), otherwise a detached instance would now have its source-code update silently discarded.
